historical_record.description: The 60-by-105.25-foot lot, 6,315 square feet, was vacant but for a flight of concrete stairs that had led to the house razed from the site.

The City Planning Commission unanimously declined to take discretionary review of the permit for a four-storey, 15-unit apartment building with 22 parking spaces on the vacant lot, letting it proceed.
The City Planning Commission unanimously approved a fifteen-unit condominium subdivision for a new building, on condition of an affirmative-action sales programme (Resolution 8215).
